theorem irrational_checkpoint_uniform_composition
  {β γ : Type*} [UniformSpace β] [UniformSpace γ]
  {f : ℝ → β} {g : β → γ}
  (x : ℝ) (y : ℚ) (h : y ≠ 0) (hx : Irrational x)
  (hf_if : Irrational (x * y) → UniformContinuous f)
  (hg : UniformContinuous g) :
  UniformContinuous (g ∘ f) := by
  have h_xy_irrational : Irrational (x * y) := by
    refine' fun h₁ => _
    
    rcases h₁ with ⟨q, hq⟩
    
    have h₂ : (x : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) / y := by
      have h₃ : (q : ℝ) = x * y := by exact_mod_cast hq
      have h₄ : (y : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact mod_cast (by simpa using h)
      field_simp [h₄] at h₃ ⊢
      <;> ring_nf at h₃ ⊢ <;> nlinarith
    
    have h₃ : ∃ (r : ℚ), (r : ℝ) = x := by
      
      have h₄ : (y : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact mod_cast (by simpa using h)
      have h₅ : (q : ℝ) / (y : ℝ) = (q / y : ℝ) := by
        norm_cast
        <;> field_simp [h₄]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> norm_cast
        <;> field_simp [h]
        <;> ring_nf
      have h₆ : (q : ℝ) / y = (q / y : ℝ) := by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h₅
      have h₇ : ∃ (r : ℚ), (r : ℝ) = x := by
        
        have h₈ : ∃ (r : ℚ), (r : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) / y := by
          
          refine' ⟨q / y, _⟩
          norm_cast
          <;> field_simp [h]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_cast
          <;> field_simp [h]
          <;> ring_nf
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h₈
        refine' ⟨r, _⟩
        
        calc
          (r : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) / y := by rw [hr]
          _ = x := by rw [h₂]
      exact h₇
    
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h₃
    have h₄ : Irrational x := hx
    exact h₄ ⟨r, by simp [hr]⟩
  
  have hf : UniformContinuous f := by
    have h₁ : Irrational (x * y) := h_xy_irrational
    have h₂ : UniformContinuous f := hf_if h₁
    exact h₂
  
  have hfg : UniformContinuous (g ∘ f) := by
    
    have h₁ : UniformContinuous (g ∘ f) := hg.comp hf
    exact h₁
  
  exact hfg
